user.title: Where is your collector?
user.description: Bindplane exports Home Assistant logs and events over OpenTelemetry to a Bindplane-managed collector.

hassio_confirm.title: Bindplane Collector found
hassio_confirm.description: The Bindplane Collector add-on is running. Set it up to send Home Assistant logs to Bindplane?

credentials.title: Connect to Bindplane
credentials.description: With an API key, Home Assistant fetches your secret key and creates a ready-to-go configuration for you.

api_key.title: Bindplane API key
api_key.description: Create an API key in Bindplane under **Settings → API Keys**.

data_description.api_url: Bindplane Cloud is https://app.bindplane.com. Use your own URL for self-hosted Bindplane.
data_description.project_id: Only needed for scoped API keys (starting with bps_).

configuration.title: Choose a configuration
configuration.description: Bindplane configurations decide where the collector sends data. Creating **{configuration}** adds an OpenTelemetry (OTLP) source that receives from Home Assistant and sends to the destinations you pick. You can change it later in Bindplane.

data_description.destinations: Only used when creating the configuration. Leave empty to add destinations later in Bindplane.

secret_key.title: Secret key
secret_key.description: Find it in Bindplane under **Install Agent**. Afterwards, attach a configuration with an OpenTelemetry (OTLP) source to the collector.

external.title: External collector
external.description: The collector needs an OpenTelemetry (OTLP) source listening on HTTP.

progress.install_addon: Installing the Bindplane Collector add-on. This can take a few minutes.

error.invalid_auth: Bindplane rejected the API key. Scoped keys (bps_) also need the project ID.
error.apply_failed: Bindplane could not create the configuration: {error}

abort.already_configured: This collector is already set up.
abort.addon_not_found: Could not find the Bindplane Collector add-on in the add-on store.
abort.addon_failed: The Bindplane Collector add-on failed to install or start. Check the Supervisor logs.
abort.addon_set_config_failed: Could not save the Bindplane Collector add-on options.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Reconfigured. The collector is reconnecting to Bindplane.

data_description.level: Home Assistant's own logger level still applies first.
data_description.exclude_loggers: Logger name prefixes to skip, e.g. homeassistant.components.recorder
data_description.events: Event types sent as log records. state_changed is very chatty.
data_description.metrics: Every minute, send numeric sensors and on/off entities as OpenTelemetry gauges.

flush.name: Flush
flush.description: Send buffered log records to the collector now.

send_test.name: Send test record
send_test.description: Emit a test log record so you can find it in your destination.
